notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Roalesk.
description:
Activate Roalesk by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Roalesk enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Roalesk trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Roalesk.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.
